messages:
alex: Hey folks — thinking of a casual couch co-op + local LAN this Saturday (5pm onwards) at the office lounge. Couch/TV for consoles and a couple PCs for Steam Remote Play. Who's in? Games I was thinking: Overcooked 2, Move or Die, Halo MCC (split-screen), Portal 2 coop, and some retro Mario Kart on Switch. Bring controllers/PCs if you can. Snacks welcome :pizza: 

riley: In! I can bring a Switch + 2 pro controllers. What time exactly? 

alex: aiming for 5–10pm. show up anytime, we'll rotate. 

sam: I'm game. Can bring an extra monitor and a PS4 controller (USB). Also can bring cables HDMI->USB capture if needed. 

jo: I can come but only after 7pm. I vote Overcooked first :joy: 

priya: Might be able to join remote via Steam Remote Play if there's room. Also happy to bring vegan snacks. 

alex: awesome — adding names: riley, sam, jo, priya. @maya you mentioned LAN last week, wanna join? 

maya: hell yeah, I'll bring the router + power strip. Also a bag of chips. :chip: 

sam: @alex can we set up a quick bracket for party games? winner gets the last slice of pizza. 

alex: love this. winner gets the last slice :trophy: 

snacks-bot: Reminder set for 2026-03-28 16:00 — 'Couch co-op setup: check controllers/cables' 

riley: Anyone needing transport after? I can drive two people home if needed. 

jo: tagging @devops-bot lol, will there be more than one HDMI? 

alex: @maya will handle power + one spare HDMI; sam said capture can fill gaps. 

priya: Count me in for remote play — what Steam handle should I use to join the session? 

alex: DM me your handle, I'll add you to the lobby. 

riley: See you Saturday! :smile: 

maya: See you all. I'll bring a screwdriver just in case :wrench:
